summary: Sedona, Arizona, independent consultant, extensive experience in software development, particularly in Ruby, Common Lisp, and Java, author of multiple technical books, strong interest in semantic web technologies, active in cloud computing (AWS, Google App Engine), enjoys hiking and cooking, family-oriented, values locally grown organic food, critical of corporate practices, advocates for financial prudence and minimal debt, has a pet parrot, engaged in community and environmental issues, follows political and economic trends closely, has a background in game AI and virtual reality, prefers working from home, has a strong preference for open-source software and programming languages that prioritize developer productivity.
